info.title: The Bazaar · Cromos de Madrid
info.summary: Trading-card negotiation game API (Causa Prima hackathon, Madrid, 2–4 Oct 2026).
info.description:
Enriched spec built by Team 1 from the server's own `/openapi.json` (which carries request schemas only), real responses captured with our team key, the official kit (`bazaar_sdk.py`, `RULES.md`) and the frontend bundles.

Every response schema carries `x-verified`: `true` means the shape was observed on the live API; `false` means it is inferred from the SDK docstrings, the rules or the frontend code and must be checked against a real response.

**Words persuade, structure binds.** Only a structured offer that its counterparty accepts moves cards or cash, and it settles on the next tick, all at once or not at all.

**Limits** (RULES.md; the numbers in force are always in `GET /api/clock` → `limits`): 5 requests/s per key with bursts of 20; 60 req/s per address without a key; per tick one accepted offer per team, one message per conversation and 12 new listings (cancelled ones count); at most 6 open conversations, one per dealer, and 30 open offers; 6 SSE streams per key. Bodies: strict JSON up to 64 KB, 8 levels deep, numbers below 10^12; prices and cash are whole primas from 1 to 10,000,000; at most 50 items on one side of an offer; messages keep 1,200 characters, venue names 40.

**Clock**: Fri 19:00–23:00 (60 s ticks), Sat 09:00–23:00 (30 s), Sun 09:00–15:00 (15 s), Madrid time. Outside those hours nothing ticks.

**Errors**: a refused request is a 4xx with `{"error": "<code>", "message": "<why>"}`; it costs nothing and moves nothing. A missing or wrong key is `bad_key` (team and broker) or `bad_token` (admin), 401. Repeated wrong-key requests from one address (about fifteen within a few minutes was enough in our run; it had cleared a few minutes later) trip `too_many_failures` (429) for every wrong-key request from that address; requests with a valid key keep working. An unknown route is `not_found`, 404.

get.description:
Unhealthy when the tick loop has died, or when it should tick and has not. Closed doors (before Friday opens,
at night, after Sunday) and a pause are not a stall: the loop keeps its heartbeat and nothing is due.

already opened keep the live hour they opened at, so everything anchored to them stays where it is.

Ring flags: pairs where one side keeps handing the other the whole pie, with the evidence per round. A flagged
pair counts as an even split (scoring.ring_pairs); clear a false positive with POST /api/admin/integrity/clear.

NewOffer.title: NewOffer
NewOffer.description: Post a structured offer on a venue (default the house market, El Rastro: 5 % + 1 P per card). Sell: `give={"assets":[id]}, want={"cash":60}`; ask for any copy: `give={"cash":40}, want={"cards":["LAV-09"]}`.

NewVenue.title: NewVenue
NewVenue.description: Needs level 2. Bond 250 P (refundable after a cooldown) + 20 P. Fees capped at 10 % and 5 P per card. Use `rules.mechanism = "board"` for your broker to act; on `auto` the engine crosses first. Opening your own venue replaces the free starter stall.

PostMessage.title: PostMessage
PostMessage.description: To a dealer, `price` is your structured offer for the thread's item. To a team, `offer = {give, want}` is a structured offer it can accept. One message per conversation per tick.

Error.description: Every refusal. Extra fields may appear (e.g. `next_tick` on a 429).

ErrorCode.description: Codes seen in the kit, the rules and the live API.

t_hours.description: Game hours since the opening; the clock stops overnight

page.description: Counts towards the album page (commons, uncommons, rares)

copy_marginals.description: Value of the 1st, 2nd and 3rd+ copy: book × set affinity × marginal

AssetBrief.description: An asset as it appears inside offers and settlements.

your_value.description: Value of this copy to you: what you lose by giving it away (the last copy's marginal)

owner.description: Your team id, or "a team" for anyone else

MyScore.description: Live score with the breakdown the public board hides.

affinity.description: Private set multipliers (same six values for every team, shuffled)

starter_broker_key.description: Appears once the free starter stall exists (SDK docstring; not yet observed)

your_value.description: Value of ONE MORE copy to you

types.description: Asset types wanted/given by kind:ref, e.g. `pack:sobre_barrio`, `card:LAV-03`

status.description: Seen: open. Others expected: accepted, cancelled, expired, queued

final.description: A dealer's last word: take it or it walks

cards.description: Any copy of these card refs (want side)

OfferSideInput.description: How you write an offer side.

Thread.description: Fields from the SDK docstring, RULES.md and starter_agent.py (which reads `status` and `standing_offers[].maker/status/want.cash/final/id`).

Topic.description: Dealer topics (SDK docstring). Team topics: a small object, ≤600 chars of JSON, ≤4 levels.

traits.description: Colour the words, not the price

Level.description: Empty list so far; fields from the SDK docstring.

EventType.description: From the frontend bundles; `x-observed-on-feed` lists the ones seen live so far.

payload.description: Type-specific; see the examples. `thread.message` carries the dealer's text and the full structured offer; `settlement` carries parties and asset ids.

your_limit.description: Seller's cost or buyer's value; a deal outside it loses points

Duel.description: From the SDK docstring (role, your_limit, rival_offer, deadline) and RULES.md; empty list until a session runs.

DuelMessage.description: A priced message in a two-issue session must carry days (or both inside `offer`), else `missing_days`.

id.description: Run id before the dash; a match pairs two offers of one run

BenchOffer.description: A bench seller asks `want.cash`; a bench buyer bids `give.cash` (starter_broker.py). Quotes shade away from hidden limits.

BrokerMatch.description: ask ≤ price and price + fee ≤ bid. Bench offers use their string ids.

FlagBody.description: A correct flag scores, a wrong one costs.

AcceptBody.description: Which of your copies to hand over when the offer asks for a card type.

FeeBody.description: Takes effect after a public notice.

Ok.description: Shape of write acknowledgements not yet observed.

TeamKey.name: X-Team-Key
TeamKey.description: Team key from the slip, `tk-xxxx-xxxx`. One team, one key.

BrokerKey.name: X-Broker-Key
BrokerKey.description: Returned once by `POST /api/venues` (`broker_key`), or `starter_broker_key` in `/api/me` once the starter stall exists.
